hooks.command: bash -c 'codex_home="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"; cli=""; if [ -n "$HARNESS_PLUGIN_ROOT" ] && [ -f "$HARNESS_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/data-harness-cli" ]; then cli="$HARNESS_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/data-harness-cli"; fi; if [ -z "$cli" ]; then for f in "$codex_home"/plugins/cache/lumi-ai-lab/harness-data/*/scripts/data-harness-cli; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; if [ -z "$cli" ] || [[ "$f" > "$cli" ]]; then cli="$f"; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$cli" ]; then echo "QDM_SETUP_REQUIRED: data-harness-cli not found. Install the harness-data Codex plugin or run harness-data setup." >&2; exit 1; fi; exec "$cli" context --format codex-hook'
